tagline: FilmCraft on a Selkies web desktop, a nonlinear video editor that cuts the footage on your array from any browser.
description: FilmCraft, a nonlinear video editor in the spirit of Premiere Pro, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: FilmCraft
